payload.reason: The evidence provides specific suggestions for improving the proposed memory-augmented dialogue systems, including enhancing computational speed, reducing parameters, and integrating memory modules with pointer networks.

claims.text: Future improvements could focus on increasing computational speed and reducing the number of parameters in memory-augmented architectures to enhance feasibility in dialogue designs.
Combining memory module architectures with pointer softmax networks may allow for better storage and retrieval of specific words from previous utterances.
Creating a system that extracts relevant features from input to select appropriate responses could improve the effectiveness of dialogue systems.
Further tuning of the NTM-LM architecture may yield better performance gains, as current results indicate only marginal improvements.
